host.description: Lumin API base URL. Defaults to LUMIN_HOST env or http://localhost:8000.

project.description: Lumin project label sent as X-Lumin-Project. Defaults to 'openclaw'.

captureSystemPrompt.description: Whether to capture the system prompt text on each model.call. Default false (system prompts are usually large and rarely actionable).

maxContentChars.description: Cap on per-attribute content size in characters. Defaults to 32768. Truncated values are tagged '...(truncated)'.

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for POST /v1/spans, milliseconds. Default 5000.
